Update as of 11/23/2026:  

 
	  Proposal Due Date has been extended via Amendment 0001 from 24 NOV to 16 DEC. See amendment for further details.  
	  RFI Response are still in progress. Responses will be posted first week of December. All offerors are advised to continue to check this Notice on SAM.gov for additional updates.  
 

  Update as of 11/04/2026:  

 
	  A 2nd Site Visit has been scheduled for 9 November 2026 @ 0900 local time (Colts Neck, NJ) 

	 
		 All attendees  MUST sign up via email  NLT 0700 11/9/26 to the below contacts:

		 
			  COR: Mr. Wayne Kolb via email at: wayne.r.kolb.civ@us.navy.mil  
			  SPAR: Mr. Nelson Jusino via email at: nelson.r.jusino.civ@us.navy.mil  
		 
		 
		 Contractors MUST meet at the Visitor Control Center located at the entrance to NWS Earle:
		 
			 201 Highway 34-S, Colts Neck, NJ. 
		 
		 
	 
	 
	 All currently submitted RFIs have been compiled, as responses become available, they will be posted here on SAM.gov.
	 
		 RFI submission deadline is extended from 11/4/26 to 11/12/26 to accomodate questions from the 2nd site visit. 
	 
	 
	 Proposal due date, at this time, remains 24 November 2026 NLT 1100 local time. 
 

 ________________________________________________ 

  Updated 10/28/2026:  

   See Section L of the Solicitation for Full Narrative Details: Pest Control Support Services   

 1. This requirement has been 100% Set-Aside for Small Business Concerns. 

 2. The purpose of the Request for Proposal (RFP) is to procure Pest Control Support Services in support of Naval Weapons Station (NWS) Earle. Services are to be performed at Colts Neck and Leonardo, New Jersey. 

 8. Offerors are highly encouraged to attend the one site visit, scheduled for Tuesday, 27 October 2026 at 0900 Eastern Standard Time (EST). Contractors MUST meet at the Visitor Control Center located at the entrance to NWS Earle: 201 Highway 34-S, Colts Neck, NJ. 

 If you plan on attending the site visit, you must sign up via email NLT Monday, 26 October 2026 by notifying the below Points of Contact, in order for adequate transportation to be arranged: 

  - Mr. Wayne Kolb via email at: wayne.r.kolb.civ@us.navy.mil  

  - Mr. Nelson Jusino via email at: nelson.r.jusino.civ@us.navy.mil  

 10. Quotes are due no later than  11:00 AM Eastern Daylight Time, Tuesday, 24 November 2026.  

 - Electronic quotes are acceptable and may be e-mailed to Jessica Mercurio at: jessica.a.mercurio.civ@us.navy.mil. 

 - Offeror’s may also request a DoD Safe Drop-Off Link, via request to Jessica Mercurio. 

   See Section M for Basis for Award and Evaluation Factors.
